messages:
Maya (Design): Quick ping — prototype for a 'Sync timeframe across panels' control is up for review: https://figma.com/proto/abc123. Idea: a toggle in the dashboard header that, when on, makes the global time picker drive all panels.

Jordan (Eng): Nice. Clarify behavior for panel-level zooms: if I zoom chart A to 10m, do other charts follow or stay at the global range?

Maya (Design): If toggle=ON then global picker overrides panels. Panel-level zoom (shift-drag) is allowed but becomes a local override shown as a dashed border and a small pill labeled 'local'. Global changes will still respect local overrides unless you hit 'Sync all'.

Sam (Product): Main concern: if users pick a very wide range (30d) and we fire 8 high-res queries at once, we could spike cost/latency. Any mitigation ideas?

Ava (SRE): Backend note: UI queries can be batched already but yes, multiple large-range requests can spike. Proposal: debounce timeframe changes (400ms), show skeleton placeholders, and add a 'defer-heavy-widgets' option that loads low-cost summaries first and full-res widgets progressively.

Jordan (Eng): UX nit: add a small sync icon in each panel header when following global timeframe with a tooltip 'Following global timeframe'. Must be keyboard-focusable and have an accessible name. Also the current pill contrast is too low — needs attention.

Maya (Design): Proposed tooltip copy: "Following global timeframe — press S to toggle sync". Thoughts on the shortcut?

Sam (Product): +1 for the shortcut. We should document it in keyboard shortcuts modal. Also: aria-live updates so screen readers announce when panels refresh due to timeframe changes.

Ava (SRE): Another flag — sampling/granularity should follow the global timeframe by default. Otherwise heatmaps/throughput panels can show mismatched resolutions. Add a small 'Sampling granularity' control in the global picker (auto / 1m / 5m / 1h).

Jordan (Eng): Agree. Implementation detail: default 'auto' selects granularity based on range length; expose dropdown for power users. Visual hint idea: show small downsampled tick marks vs full resolution when auto is active.

Maya (Design): I'll update the Figma with these states and a11y checklist: focus order, aria-labels, contrast >=4.5:1 for pills, keyboard shortcut handling, and clear announcement messages. I'll upload a prototype by Monday.

DevBot: Prototype deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.internal/dashboards/latency?feature=sync-timeframe — please smoke test and leave quick comments.

Sam (Product): :thumbsup: If no objections I'll scope the 'defer-heavy-widgets' feature flag for Dedicated customers and add an ops-runbook for rollout thresholds.
